title: Dick Billings visits Sheehan over the sealed Iran-Contra complaint

tellings.quote: he said there aren't two men in the world that would have answered that question that way he said my name is was Dick Billings I was the chief staff writer for the house select committee on assassinations I think I can help you out on this case

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says that while he was working on a sealed racketeering lawsuit, filed by his public-interest law group, the Christic Institute, over the Iran-Contra affair (a 1980s scandal over secret US arms deals and covert operations), a stranger came to his office at 1324 North Capitol Street in Washington. The man had heard how Sheehan answered a question and said "there aren't two men in the world that would have answered that question that way." He introduced himself as Dick Billings, who had been the chief staff writer for a congressional committee that investigated assassinations, and told Sheehan, "I think I can help you out on this case."
